Defeating the Great Demon (Conquering the Great Demon (Page 22)) Mrs. Liu obviously didn't think so much. She was so frightened that she immediately knelt down in front of the old lady. She told with snot and tears how she had worked hard and uncomplainingly in the Xia family over the years. She cried miserably. It was not the usual angry and dangerous look, but a very strange look with a touch of sadness. It's not that I didn't try to convince myself, but it was The disappointment in my mother's eyes was too strong to hide, so I couldn't even deceive myself. His dark eyes were clear and sharp, and there was still a careless smile on his lips. If his face were not too pale, it would be impossible to tell that he was still injured. At this time, because of this shocking scene, more and more passers-by were gathering here. After speaking to the news media on behalf of the Miracle Era, as an insider, I certainly would not blindly believe it. I was so frightened that I quickly grabbed the handrail and jumped back to the stairs. I was found hanging on the handrail with open arms, while Tang Wei walked over silently and ate with his head down, while everyone was waiting for Yun Shao to be confessed. When he was in a panic, there was a man in a casual suit, his lips curled up in a calm expression, and he walked calmly along the flow of people towards the teaching building. However, even so, the few of them got along very well and chatted for a while. Finally at a certain point, Yunyang gently pulled the trigger, and the bullet accurately hit the bullseye five hundred meters away.
